home.heroText: LUMEN is a Paris-based association that designs and coordinates European projects for education, digital skills and the green transition, with and for young people.
home.aboutTitle: An association that brings the light of knowledge where it is missing
home.aboutText: LUMEN – Learning and Digital Modernisation European Network – is a non-profit association (loi 1901) founded in Paris in 2026. We believe the light of knowledge should be accessible to everyone. That is why we build bridges between technology, education and society.

greenPoints: Low-carbon mobility: train and car-sharing first (Green Travel)
Responsible digital: frugal tools, reused equipment
Circular economy and climate at the heart of learning content

about.metaDescription: Mission, vision, values, team and legal information of LUMEN, a non-profit association based in Paris.
about.title: Building bridges between technology, education and society
about.intro: Founded in Paris in 2026, LUMEN is a public-interest association working on education, citizenship, the environment and digital skills.
storyText: LUMEN was born from a simple observation: digital transformation is moving fast, but not for everyone. Too many young people are left out of future skills, artificial intelligence and mobility opportunities in Europe.
We chose the name LUMEN, "light" in Latin, because our role is to shed light: to make knowledge accessible, show the paths that exist and support those who take them.
about.objectText: To promote non-formal education, digital transformation and technological innovation among young people and professionals through European and international mobility projects, to develop training in future skills (Industry 4.0, artificial intelligence), to support the exchange of good practice and to encourage active citizenship.
about.legalIntro: For our partners and funders: legal identity and governance.
about.legalGovernanceText: Board of two members elected for three years; unpaid roles and non-profit management.

faq.q: Can LUMEN already coordinate a project?
faq.a: Yes for small-scale partnerships and youth exchanges; for larger projects we start as a partner alongside experienced organisations.

faq.q: Do you have an OID number?
faq.a: Our registration on the European Commission's organisation platform is in progress. Write to us to get the number as soon as it is issued.

faq.q: Which languages do you work in?
Which target groups can you involve?
faq.a: Young people aged 13 to 30, with priority for those with fewer opportunities, as well as youth and education professionals.
